The representatives of 87 MKs recommended Sharon as the next Prime Minister. Only Labor (19 seats), Meretz (6), and the Arab parties (8) did not recommend Sharon.
"87 חברי כנסת המליצו לי להטיל את המשימה על אריאל שרון. שרון הודיעני כי הוא מסכים לקבל על עצמו את המשימה."

notes: Consultations with President Katsav ran 3–6 February 2003 (Ra'am, the last faction, met him on the evening of the 6th); Sharon was given the mandate on Sunday 9 February. Per-list split (Likud 38, Shinui 15, Shas 11, National Union 7, NRP 6, UTJ 5, One Nation 3, Yisrael BaAliyah 2) equals the President's 87. Haaretz returned 403 to a direct request on 2026-11-05; its quote is from a search-index extract.
